fixed_factors: Case prompt and fixture initial state
Installed project dependency versions copied without hard links
limits: Eight local task instances do not estimate general agent quality.
Reserved H1/H2 are held back from iterative runs but are not author-unknown blind tasks.
Objective checks do not establish prose quality or curriculum coherence.
Fresh isolated execution may still vary stochastically.
Manual rubric must inspect artifacts and traces without seeing variant labels where feasible.

grading.status: FAIL for demonstrated acceptance or preservation violation; INFRA for failed grading runtime with no demonstrated task failure; PASS means automated checks passed, subject to explicitly pending human rubric.
grading.word_count: English words matched by letters with optional internal apostrophe or hyphen; Markdown syntax excluded where possible.
grading.semantic_policy: Do not grade prose quality by banned-word counts or demand one reference wording. Human reviewers evaluate factual preservation, invention and unsupported claims against the case record.
grading.objective_claim_limit: Automated signals on free-text answers are minimal presence checks only. They must not be reported as full semantic correctness.
grading.d1_missing_deck_mutation: The starter build already rejects broken source links. To isolate spec behavior, the grader builds valid source in its independent copy, removes only dist/decks/week-01/index.html there, then runs Vitest. The unlinked-deck negative case is a source mutation and rebuild.
grading.d1_test_shape_independence: D1 does not prescribe assertion count, test names or implementation shape. Positive cases require a nonempty all-passing suite. Controlled negative mutations require one or more actual failed assertions, with no skipped/todo outcomes. Unchanged protected test files in D3/D4/H1 retain their original expected-red identification.
grading.d1_source_scope: D1 permits PLAN.md and new direct spec/*.ts helpers/tests. Only spec/course-promises.test.ts is editable among existing spec files; all other existing spec files remain protected. Relatedness and needless abstraction go to human review.
